summary: Typosquat npm package drops unverified executable from anonymous share URL at install
details: The package is published as sol-wallet-adapater, a one-letter transposition of the widely used sol-wallet-adapter, but ships unrelated celest-browser code and README with no Solana wallet functionality. Its postinstall script fetches a binary from https://peerbox.cloud/s/nSXWTpGsFd4qmzNJqWYs4w, an anonymous file-share token unrelated to any Chromium publisher, writes it to ~/.celest/bin/chrome, and chmods it 0755. There is no version pin and no hash or signature verification. The dropped binary is then launched via puppeteer-core executablePath whenever consumers call the exported fetch/get/post methods, so installing the package stages an unverifiable executable from a mutable anonymous host and wires it into runtime execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
